;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**A [[suicide bombing]] in [[Char Asiab]], [[Kabul Province]], kills three civilians and injures 15. No group has claimed responsibility yet. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attacks/bombing-near-afghan-capital-kills-three-amid-unabated-violence-idUSKCN22B0HD (Reuters)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**[[Northern Rakhine State clashes]]
***[[Yanghee Lee]], the [[United Nations special rapporteur]], accuses the [[Myanmar Armed Forces]] of intensifying their attacks on civilians in [[Rakhine State|Rakhine]] and [[Chin State|Chin]] [[states of Myanmar|states]]. The [[Myanmar government]] blames [[Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army|Rohingya insurgents]] and the [[separatist]] [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]] for the violence. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rakhine/myanmar-military-may-be-committing-new-war-crimes-says-departing-rights-envoy-idUSKBN22B1KG?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Terrorism in Russia]]
**The [[Federal Security Service]] carries out an [[anti-terrorist]] raid near [[Yekaterinburg]], [[Sverdlovsk Oblast]], to thwart planned attacks in the city. Three suspects, reportedly linked to [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]], are killed in an exchange of gunfire. [https://meduza.io/news/2020/04/30/v-ekaterinburge-ubity-troe-podozrevaemyh-v-podgotovke-teraktov (''Meduza'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Icheon fire]]
**A fire at a four-story [[warehouse]] under construction in [[Icheon]], [[South Korea]], kills 38 construction workers and injures 10 others. An additional 40 people remain unaccounted for. The fire is the most deadly in the country since [[Daegu subway fire|2003]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52472799 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/30/south-korea-fire-kills-nearly-40-construction-workers (''The Guardian'')]
*A [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Sikorsky CH-148 Cyclone|CH-148 Cyclone]] helicopter vanishes while flying over the [[Ionian Sea]] during a [[NATO]] mission. One body is recovered, while the five other persons on board remain missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52480925 (BBC News)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/canadian-nato-helicopter-goes-missing-off-greek-island-air-force (''The Straits Times'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Yemen]]
**[[Yemen]]i authorities in [[Aden]] report five cases of [[COVID-19]], the highest total to date, amid fears that the disease could be spreading undetected in a country where millions face [[famine]] and lack medical care. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-yemen/yemen-records-multiple-coronavirus-cases-for-first-time-u-n-fears-more-idUSKBN22B2CJ?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]], [[Venezuela–Colombia migrant crisis]]
**Over 500 [[Venezuela]]n migrants block a major [[toll road]] in northern [[Bogotá]], [[Colombia]], demanding they be allowed to return home after the coronavirus pandemic caused economic opportunities to dry up. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-healthcare-coronavirus-colombia-migra/venezuelan-migrants-block-bogota-road-demand-ability-to-travel-home-idUSKBN22B2YM?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[U.S. Congressman]] [[Justin Amash]] joins the [[Libertarian Party (United States)|Libertarian Party]] and announces his bid for the [[2020 United States presidential election|presidency]]. This also makes him the first Libertarian in Congress in the party's 48-year history. [https://reason.com/2020/04/29/justin-amash-becomes-the-first-libertarian-member-of-congress/ (Reason)]
*[[Giacomo dalla Torre del Tempio di Sanguinetto]], incumbent [[List of Grand Masters of the Knights Hospitaller|Prince and Grand Master of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta]] dies from cancer at the age of 75. [[Ruy Gonçalo do Valle Peixoto de Villas Boas]] succees him as Lieutenant ''ad interim'' of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/dalla-torre-grand-master-knights-malta-dies-75-70411648 (ABC News)]
;Science and technology
*{{mpl|(52768) 1998 OR|2}}, a [[near-Earth object|near-Earth asteroid]] that is {{convert|2|km|mi|sp=us}} wide, makes a close approach of {{convert|0.042|AU|e6km LD|sigfig=2|abbr=unit|lk=on}} to Earth. It will not approach closer than this until 2079. [https://news.sky.com/story/mile-wide-asteroid-will-skim-past-earth-today-at-19-000mph-11980370 (Sky News)]
